name: lost-signal
description: LOST SIGNAL — browser-based first-person Backrooms survival horror (Prototype 0.1)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: node tools/assets/fetch-external.mjs || echo "[external] skipped"; npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
